title: BA: explicit go/no-go evidence ledger and source coverage gaps
public_pr_body:
Maps all 41 repository first-day boxes, 36 manual rehearsal steps and eight candidate reviewer conditions, plus release/transfer gates. Four PASS rows cite historical executed counts and exact heads; missing runtime proof stays NOT TESTED. Absent 140-143 packaging is a demonstrated FAIL.

Assumption/limitation: no exact Go Live Operations Pack was found in fetched history. This ledger names the repository sources used, and full private/external pack coverage remains BLOCKED until matched. No completeness or release verdict invented. Initial validation expected nine matrix rows; inspection confirmed eight source conditions, and exact source-to-ledger comparison passed for all eight. 41/36 source counts, evidence fields and diff checks passed. No runtime tests/SQL/deployment.
